reason: Runner implementation authorization v1 was superseded before use by the frozen output-normalization amendment. This v2 authorization pins the amended adapter and output-contract identities and authorizes implementation of the reusable truth-blind comparator benchmark runner.
requirements: Implement a reusable comparator benchmark runner for the eight frozen workflows: ARPIP, FastML, HomoplasyFinder, PAML, PastML, POUTINE, SNPPar and TreeTime.
Do not execute any of the frozen 150 benchmark scenarios during implementation or validation.
Do not execute any third-party comparator during implementation or validation.
Do not read canonical benchmark truth during runner implementation or validation.

Comparator execution must be structurally truth-blind: command construction, subprocess environments, output parsing and normalization may receive only comparator-facing inputs, frozen metadata and runtime configuration.
Truth paths, truth objects and truth-derived values must not enter command construction, subprocess environments, comparator invocation, native-output parsing or prediction normalization.
Use the frozen environment/run contracts and frozen adapter functions; do not reimplement scientific normalization logic inside the runner.
Runtime executable, environment, source and build locations must be supplied externally; the reusable runner must not hard-code /home/rwhite/branchsnv-comparator-* paths.
Use isolated method-by-scenario working directories.
Preserve command metadata, exit status, stdout, stderr and native comparator outputs.
Normalize predictions only after successful comparator invocation and only through frozen adapter functions.
Record timeout, non-zero exit, missing required output, malformed output and normalization failure as explicit completion failures; never substitute zero-accuracy predictions.
Separate comparator execution/normalization from truth scoring. Normalized prediction identities must be finalized before truth is supplied to the scoring phase.
Use the frozen metric functions unchanged.
Validation must use synthetic temporary fixtures only; it must not use S001-S150.
Fail closed on unknown methods, missing comparator-facing inputs, unexpected native outputs, pre-existing result roots or inconsistent frozen identities.

PastML normalization must parse reconstructed_states.tsv, map PastML named.tree_tree.nwk nodes to the benchmark tree by descendant-tip identity, and convert projected state indices back to frozen genomic variable positions using events_from_projected_node_sequences().
SNPPar branch events must use parse_snppar_mutation_events(); recurrent-site calls must use snppar_recurrent_sites_from_branch_events() on homoplasic_events_all_calls.tsv.
TreeTime node sequences may be mapped by map_node_sequences_by_descendant_tips(); recurrent-site calls must use treetime_recurrent_sites_from_branch_events() on normalized ancestral branch events.
Do not score TreeTime homoplasy CLI top-N output.
Do not infer cross-tool branch identity from comparator-specific internal node labels.
